definitions: An enzyme produced by leukocytes (white blood cells) that can be detected in urine, indicating the presence of white blood cells and potential urinary tract infection.
A diagnostic test that detects the presence of leukocyte esterase in a urine sample.
examples: A positive leukocyte esterase test suggests a UTI.
The lab report showed elevated leukocyte esterase.
Leukocyte esterase is an indicator of inflammation.
